verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as batch-dispatching agents, mass outbound calls or bulk room management, are a fair question for a voice-agent framework and platform. However, the evidence pack documents no capability for acting on many items at once. Outbound trunks, the CLI and tool use cover single actions or general building blocks, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
